# GeoClick Capture 1.4.0 — Match & Verify

GeoClick Capture now helps users detect possible duplicate places before a new point is created.

## Highlights

- New **Match & Verify** tab beside Capture Log and Search & Capture.
- Scan one selected point layer or every visible point layer.
- Configurable search radius from 10 m to 50 km.
- Preferred name-field selection or automatic comparison across text fields.
- Accent-insensitive name matching and geodesic distance measurement.
- Explainable confidence score from 0 to 100.
- High, Medium and Low duplicate-risk classifications.
- Explicit **Use existing** and **Create new** decisions; the plugin never chooses automatically.
- Audit fields for the decision, matched layer and feature, distance, name similarity, confidence, risk and review requirement.
- Six new SVG icons aligned with the existing visual system.
- New pure-Python unit tests for matching and candidate ordering.

Search & Capture, snapping, reverse geocoding, session management and CSV/GeoJSON/GeoPackage export remain available.
